g.text: Connected UPS load (DCS 22, SIS/BMS 14, F&G 6, telecom 8, analysers 6, misc 4)
Battery power at design load (PF 0.9, inverter 94 %)
Max. discharge current at end voltage 336 V (192 x 1.75 V)
Capacity = I x Kt 1.1 h (30 min) x aging 1.25 x margin 1.1
125 V DC duty: L1 60 A 1 min (trip) / L2 15 A 120 min standing / L3 40 A 1 min (close)
125 V DC battery incl. aging 1.25, margin 1.10
Distributed control system (controllers, I/O, servers, HMI in FAR)
Safety instrumented system incl. H-101/H-201 BMS, ESD solenoids
Misc. instrument panels, MCC/IED networking, metering
1. Emergency diesel generator NOT provided. Basis: two independent 13.8 kV feeders from the
refinery main substation; the unit fails safe on total power loss (SIS de-energise-to-trip,
fail-safe valves, heater BMS trip); no machinery needs post-trip power (no lube-oil / seal-oil
systems, API 682 seals, steam ejectors). Essential loads (DCS, SIS/BMS, F&G, PAGA/telecom) on
UPS 30 min; escape lighting self-contained 90 min. To be confirmed by HAZOP and the refinery
2. UPS: 2 x 100 % dual-bus (UPS-101A -> UDB-101A, UPS-101B -> UDB-101B), each with own battery,
static bypass and external maintenance bypass; 100 kVA each; input 480 V 3-ph 60 Hz (from
MCC-101A/B); output 208Y/120 V 3-ph, 120 V 1-ph distribution, 60 Hz.
3. Consumers with redundant PSUs fed from both UDBs; single-fed loads via static transfer switch
4. UPS battery: VRLA, 2 V cells, 20-yr design life, in ventilated battery room in SS-100; 192
cells, 350 Ah, 30 min at design load.
5. 125 V DC: 2 x 100 % chargers, 2 x 100 % batteries, DCDB-101 with A/B sections; batteries 75 Ah
6. Battery rooms ventilated per IEEE 1635 / NFPA 70E; DC system ungrounded with ground-fault
batteries; DCDB sections A/B with N.O. tie
